messages.subject: For Tristan Pascall | Responsible copper growth, country trust and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Devas,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Tristan Pascall, Chief Executive Officer.

First Quantum's responsible-growth agenda increasingly depends on the quality of country relationships surrounding its copper portfolio. As demand for copper rises, long-term value will continue to depend on strong host-government engagement, community trust, environmental discipline and clear internal accountability for external commitments.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My operating mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, community engagement, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I routinely convert external requirements into accountable actions across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement and technical teams.

I would value a senior conversation about where this country-facing experience might support First Quantum's responsible growth, stakeholder strategy, government relations or regional leadership needs. My attached CV has been prepared specifically around that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
